live_book.known_hole: Live shelf had only 3 AUS pins (all AirTrunk). This dry-run adds net-new named campuses from allowed SoR. Do NOT publish.

method_notes: Sweep: Equinix (xScale only), Digital Realty, AirTrunk, Vantage, STACK, NTT, STT, Keppel, CapitaLand, DayOne/GDS, ESR, PDG, Colt, NEXTDC, CDC, Macquarie Telecom/DC, YOURDC, DCI, EdgeConneX, Empyrion, Microsoft, Google, AWS, Meta, Apple, Goodman, Frasers.

Places swept: Eastern Creek, Marsden Park, Horsley Park, Rosehill, Kemps Creek, Macquarie Park, Artarmon, Huntingwood/Lane Cove (AirTrunk soft), Erskine Park; Melbourne Tullamarine, Truganina, Brooklyn, Laverton, West Footscray, Port Melbourne, Derrimut (hint); Canberra Hume/Fyshwick/Beard; Perth Maddington/Malaga; Brisbane/Gold Coast/Adelaide/Darwin (NEXTDC nav only where MW+place on primary).

Allowed SoR only: company IR/press/official DC; ASX PDFs; NSW Planning Portal / SEARS. Forbidden SoR (Baxtel, DataCenterMap, AIDCI, DC Byte, Wikipedia, consultant averages, news-only recaps) used as hints then verified or rejected.

Grain kept: IT/ICT ≠ facility/power/operational capacity ≠ interconnection/substation ≠ generation/PPA. Sub-250 disclosed pins stay (CDC Canberra campuses, Equinix xScale, Vantage 64, DCI 63, NEXTDC S1/S2/M1, etc.).
Equinix IBX rejected; Equinix xScale Rosehill passed. Soft corridors without suburb (AirTrunk SYD1/SYD2) rejected. Live AirTrunk MEL1/MEL2/SYD3 marked duplicate_of_live.
Geocoder: Photon (komoot) suburb centroids after Nominatim shell calls were auto-review blocked. Dry-run only. Fetch cache: /workspace/state/campus-hunt/australia-fetch/.
Do NOT publish to compute.world or GitHub.
